patient_notes.body: Overnight obs unremarkable. Slept through, no analgesia required.
Wound dressing changed at 09:30. Site clean, no discharge or surrounding redness.
Vitals stable through the morning. BP 124/78, temp 37.1, SpO2 97% on room air.
Amoxicillin course extended by 48 hours per Dr. Mehta following the latest bloods.
Mobilised to the chair twice with assistance. Reports pain 3/10 on movement.
Paracetamol 500mg given at 10:00 for mild post-op discomfort. Tolerated well.
Dr. Mehta reviewed at rounds and stepped IV fluids down to maintenance rate. Reassess at 20:00.
Reported nausea after breakfast; antiemetic held pending doctor review. Do not restart oral intake without sign-off.
